name: senior-dev-squad
description: Senior dev squad: 1 lean core SDLC plugin + 26 specialty plugins (107 skills across 27 plugins).

plugins.name: senior-dev-squad
plugins.description: Lean senior-engineer SDLC core: spec, architecture, frontend/backend, data/DB, testing, systematic debugging, code/security review, DevOps/SRE, ship readiness, plus guardrails and cross-cutting senior-dev workflow skills. Specialty suites (product, marketing, security/compliance, AI/ML, MCP, agent-platform) ship as separate opt-in plugins.
